title: Global AI-compute supply-chain evidence layer
purpose: Assemble public evidence relevant to Track 3 accounting of pre-deal compute production, sales, ownership and physical end use without treating aggregate estimates as transaction-level proof.

status_semantics.INGESTED_SNAPSHOT: Repository contains a dated source snapshot or derived table.
status_semantics.PUBLIC_OFFICIAL_SOURCE: Official public source is cataloged but not ingested transaction-level data.
status_semantics.PARTIAL: Some chain elements are represented; complete reconciliation is not possible from the retained public source.
status_semantics.UNKNOWN: A numeric/global closure cannot be computed without missing transaction or inspection data.

source_layers.role: Aggregate organization/owner snapshots; cumulative rows overlap in time and must not be summed across dates.
Quarter/chip estimated unit and H100e flows; not invoices, serial records, or guaranteed shipments.
Organization-level user snapshots; physical location linkage remains separate.
Upstream component-supply and implied production constraints.
Current public disclosure of direct/indirect customer structure, product scope, geography and controlled-compute export exposure.
Upstream manufacturing/packaging capacity context and global manufacturing footprint.
Public U.S. merchandise import/export data by HS code, geography, quantity/value and shipping information; commodity classifications are broader than individual accelerator models.
Global legal-entity identity plus direct/ultimate parent relationships.
Latest public Level 1/Level 2 files available 2026-09-25 in the current web check.
Issuer subsidiary lists and corporate-family evidence for public companies.
Official WEEE collection/reuse/recycling reporting context relevant to decommissioning/attrition modeling.

closure_requirements: Every pre-deal production estimate needs a source/date and unit definition.
Every direct sale used in deterministic audit needs a vendor-recipient relation.
Every resale/transfer needs source and destination entities where recorded.
Current-owner identity must resolve through the entity graph.
Physical end use requires site evidence or authorized inspection; company-level ownership is not enough.
Decommissioning requires recycler/destruction corroboration or remains in the residual pool.
public_source_limit: No public source found in this pass provides a globally exhaustive transaction-level serial-number ledger of all AI accelerators. Therefore a complete numeric global untraced-compute value cannot honestly be filled from public data alone.
